text: Lapatinib is an FDA-approved, small-molecule ATP-competitive tyrosine kinase inhibitor that directly binds to the intracellular kinase domain of ERBB2 (HER2), stabilizing the receptor in an inactive conformation. In HER2-positive breast cancer, amplification or overexpression of ERBB2 leads to constitutive receptor dimerization and hyperactivation of downstream oncogenic signaling pathways, primarily MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT. By blocking ERBB2 autophosphorylation, lapatinib effectively halts these signal transduction cascades, resulting in inhibited tumor cell proliferation and the induction of apoptosis.
